preheader: Anthropic's record IPO debut, Intuit sells Mailchimp for $3.7B, and Model ML raises $250M.

lead.headline: Anthropic completes record $107B IPO as tech stocks pull back
lead.body: Anthropic went public in a record-setting $107.3 billion offering that valued the company at $1.8 trillion. Shares opened at $111.50 before closing at $97.17 on its first day. The debut coincided with a broader market decline, with the Dow dropping 1,101 points.
lead.why: Understanding how public markets price massive AI companies gives you critical context for valuation models in your finance classes and potential tech investments.

stories.headline: Intuit sells Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.7B
stories.body: Intuit agreed to sell email marketing service Mailchimp to Italian tech firm Bending Spoons for about $3.7 billion. Intuit bought the company for $12 billion just five years ago.
stories.why: Analyzing huge corporate write-downs helps you understand real-world M&A deal structures and valuation errors in business strategy.

stories.headline: Trump discloses stock trades in Nvidia and SpaceX
stories.body: President Donald Trump disclosed hundreds of stock and bond transactions from September. The filings showed investments in major companies like Nvidia and SpaceX.
stories.why: Monitoring how political figures hold assets in regulated tech firms helps you evaluate policy risk in market investing.

stories.headline: Apple is building AI agents to operate Macs
stories.body: Apple is working on AI agents that can control Mac applications, write code, and navigate websites for users. Bloomberg reported the project after spotting recent job postings at the company.
stories.why: Operating system level AI agents could change how software startups build apps and how tech consultants evaluate desktop productivity.

stories.headline: OpenAI begins testing Dots with ChatGPT Plus subscribers
stories.body: OpenAI has started testing its Dots feature with select ChatGPT Plus users. The tool was previously restricted to higher tier Pro, Business, and Enterprise accounts.
stories.why: Tracking how top AI platforms roll out features helps you analyze product tiering and monetization strategies in tech.

stories.headline: McKinsey report shows sustainability risks threaten 20% of EBITDA
stories.body: A new McKinsey report shows that sustainability risks and opportunities can impact corporate free cash flow by up to 20% of EBITDA. The firm advised chief executives to personally manage sustainability strategies.
stories.why: Consulting interviews focus heavily on core metrics like EBITDA, so knowing industry benchmarks will sharpen your case interview answers.

stories.headline: UC Irvine opens new Disability Cultural Center
stories.body: UC Irvine has launched a Disability Cultural Center directed by Naty Rico. The center offers a supportive space to destigmatize disability and help Anteaters thrive on campus.

stories.headline: Ben Shelton advances to ATP Finals semifinals
stories.body: Ben Shelton defeated Spain's Rafael Jodar 7-6(8), 7-5 in Turin. The victory secured his spot in the ATP Finals semifinals after Arthur Fils lost his opening set to Alexander Zverev.

term.name: EBITDA
term.definition: EBITDA stands for Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization. It measures a company's operational profitability by stripping away tax structures and accounting decisions. McKinsey highlighted today that sustainability factors could impact long-term cash flows by up to 20% of EBITDA.

serve.headline: Model ML raises $250M at $1.5B valuation for finance AI agents
serve.body: London startup Model ML raised $250 million in Series B funding co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors. The company builds AI agents specifically tailored for consultants, bankers, and investors.
